title: Aaradhana me hai chutkara, aaradhana me hai changai

lines.text: Aaradhana me hai chutkara, aaradhana me hai changai
Shareer pran aatma me shanti anand deta hai
Prarthana kare aaradhana kare, wo acha hai kitna bhala hai -(2)
Mangoge to milega, dhundoge to paoge - 2
Prarthana karo nirantar, prarthana karo vishwas se - 2
Dharmi jan ki prarthana vishwas ki prarthana

chords:
[Verse 1]
Aaradhana me hai chutkara, aaradhana me hai changai
Shareer pran aatma me shanti anand deta hai
Jaan se pyara prabhu |

[CHORUS]
Prarthana kare aaradhana kare, wo acha hai kitna bhala hai -(2)
Chutkara paaye hamesha -(2)

[Verse 2]
Mangoge to milega, dhundoge to paoge - 2
Khatkhatao khulengi swarg ki aashishe
Pao tum use abhi |

[Verse 3]
Prarthana karo nirantar, prarthana karo vishwas se - 2
Dharmi jan ki prarthana vishwas ki prarthana
Kholti hai sare bandhan ko |
